Resolves #3255

Adds a `-m, --createStore <value>` CLI flag and an interactive prompt (`Do you want to create a matching data.Store?`, `yes`/`no`) to `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` when `baseClass === 'data.Model'`, passing the exact generated `modelFile` and `modelName` into `createClass` to generate the companion `data.Store` with collision-safe model import naming (`Store` -> `StoreModel`). Also fixes the missing assignment on `importName.replace(new RegExp('ies$'), 'y')` and depth-aware relative path resolution (`'../'.repeat(ns.length)`) in `case 'data.Store'`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs` + `check-jsdoc-types.mjs`) → L2 required (unit-testable CLI class-generator behavior).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit tests and check-jsdoc-types ran`

## Deltas from ticket
- Passed `modelFile` and `modelName` directly from the `data.Model` creation step to the companion `data.Store` generator so root and non-`model` namespaces (`MyApp.User`, `MyApp.domain.User`) resolve the exact model path, disambiguated collision-prone model identifiers (`Store` -> `StoreModel`), and repaired `importName = importName.replace(new RegExp('ies$'), 'y')` and nested namespace relative path calculation (`'../'.repeat(ns.length)`) inside `case 'data.Store'`.
